facility.name: Finger Prints Learning Day Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 901 VETERANS BLVD, PALMVIEW, TX, 78572

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Diaper changing mat in the infant room is torn and there were two uncovered dirty diapers on the diaper changing station. High chair seat attached to a table has multiple stains.     There are bird dropping on top of the outdoor play kitchen and three play houses.     There is an active red ant pile in the outdoor play area.     Note: During inspection provider disposed of the dirty diapers and removed / replaced the seat attached to the table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: One of the tricycle has a broken seat. Four of the tricycles are missing pedals. There are overgrown weeds in the outdoor play area. There is an unanchored metal pole by the soccer goals. The nets of the soccer goals are broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Vehicle Documentation - date of lease or purchase for each vehicle: Operation has a transportation vehicle designed to seat eight or more persons without an electronic child safety alarm. Documentation showing when center first purchased or leased a vehicle was not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Vehicle Documentation - date of lease or purchase for each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5627)

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age Interest Centers Clearly Defined: Operation does not have well defined interest centers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age Interest Centers Clearly Defined (26 TAC §746.2605(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Last fire inspection was conducted on 02/10/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Four children's records were reviewed. One files was not available for review, including the feeding instructions. Three files were missing the updated special care statement. A file was missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children ages 6mo, 16mo and 3yo were watching Mickey Mouse Club House.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Two staff files were reviewed. One file is missinng annual training certificates on the topics of management, abuse/neglect, hazardous materials, food allergies, administering medications, emergency prepardness, building safety and communicable diseases. The second file was not available for review including pre-service and first aid/CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: Last active play space and equipment daily check was documented on 2/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: At arrival, an infant-age child was asleep and unsupervised in room #3.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Children did not wash hands before lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: Last health inspection was conducted on 02/10/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs: Operation did not have current lesson plans nor planned activities for the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs (26 TAC §746.2201)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Operation was found in disorder and disrepair. There is an accumulation of dust on the walls, fans and equipment. Part of the flooring is torn. There are stacks and bags of equipment within the classrooms. Part of the outdoor fence is broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: Menu did not match the food items served during lunch.   Operation did not serve a fruit nor vegetable portion during lunch.     Two food items served during lunch time were expired; milk 12/03/2024 and ham 11/18/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 6mo child was asleep in a crib with a blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: A 3yo child was placed in a high chair for standing up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies reviewed were missing the following information:    (1) The criteria you will use to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play;    (2)  Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs. The policy must address the requirements outlined in ?746.2202 of this chapter (relating to What are my responsibilities when planning activities for a child in care with special care needs?); and     (3) Inform parents that they may visit the child-care center at any time during your hours of operationto observe their child, the child-care center's program activities, the building, the premises, and the equipment without having to secure prior approval.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director did not have current training in transportation safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Children's Products Certification form used to prove that the operation has reviewed each of the recall notices issued by the CPSC and that there are no unsafe products in the home was not current. The form available for review had a date of February 09, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: A wall in a children's restroom was observed with peeling paint accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2023 data from January 18, 2024, revealed the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2023 by January 15, 2023, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits: A window designated as an emergency exit was blocked with a children's table and boxes of children's materials. A tree branch was observed  blocking the window from the outside as a large piece of the tree branch was hanging in front of the window. This prevented children and staff from safely exiting through the window in case of an emergency.       Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as a different window was designated as an emergency exit within the same room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher in the transportation vehicle was not serviced. The last service date on the fire extinguisher was on February 2021. A fire extinguisher in the center was not currently serviced. The last service date on the fire extinguisher was on January 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 of 4 children's files reviewed was missing the child's immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The center did not have an annual health inspection completed. Most recent health inspection provided is dated 2/01/2022 and a renewal inspection is due every twelve months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: A  first aid kit was not available in the transportation vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The center did not have an annual fire inspection completed. Most recent fire inspection provided is dated 2/01/2022 and a renewal inspection is due every twelve months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's products certification form used for verification that the center has reviewed each of the recall notices issued by the CPSC and ensured that there are no unsafe products in the center was not current. The date documented on the form was 1/24/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Two fire extinguishers were not currently serviced. The service date on the tag was January 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies reviewed were missing the following information:    Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity:    (A) The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play;    (B) The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor;    (C) The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation;    (D) Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place;    (E) The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities; and    (F) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregiver was missing annual training of the following topics.    At least 6 clock hours of annual training hours must be in one or more of the following topics:  (1)Child growth and development;  (2)Guidance and discipline;  (3)Age-appropriate curriculum; and  (4)Teacher-child interaction.     At least 1 clock hour of the annual training hours must focus on prevention, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: Both director's were missing annual training on the following topics:    (1)Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma;    (2)Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS); and    (3)Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Two electrical outlets were observed without a safety cover in the pre-k room. This posed a safety hazard as the electrical outlets were within children's reach.         Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as safety covers were placed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Both director's were missing current annual training on Transportation Safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
